test_sample_task_happy_path: test the ProjectSampleTask.post endpoint creates a complete sample task with annotations and predictions
test_sample_task_fallback_generate_task: test fallback to Project.get_sample_task when LabelInterface.generate_complete_sample_task raises an exception
test_sample_task_fallback_prediction: test fallback to Project.get_sample_task when LabelInterface.generate_sample_prediction returns None
test_sample_task_no_annotation_flag: test that include_annotation_and_prediction=False bypasses generate_complete_sample_task and uses simple sample task
test_sample_task_default_behavior: test that omitting include_annotation_and_prediction defaults to False and calls only get_sample_task
